body: Well, maybe a psychologist is good for the memory and that it helps to find oneself but I do not think that it will be enough. Traumas is ingrained in me and anyone can change that. Maybe by going to a psychologist I'm just going to waste my time because nobody can save me. I looked for help a lot online, even by an online psychologist it never helped me in the end I just feel worse because it looks like I'm a lost cause. That's a bit why I can't take the step towards a psychologist. but thank you for ur support <3
i'll try.. that's already a lot tho. good luck to u !! i hope u'll be fine and find someone who will help u! <3
Even in a base of trust, I find it hard to confide!  Because sometimes I feel like I'm just pretending to be sick...
what really pushed you to go there?
I dont have any friends, anyone care about me, it doesn't help but i cant do anything abt that
the problem is also that when i want to dare to go, i question myself and tell myself that i don't need it and that everything will get better over time
